## async

Fetch-then-render container: loads one data source, showing a loading slot while in flight, then the content slot with the response bound as $data.<source.id> (or the error slot on failure).

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `source` | `DataSource` | ✓ | The data source to load. Its id becomes the $data key inside content. |
| `loading` | `Component` |  | Shown while fetching. Defaults to a centred spinner. |
| `content` | `Component` | ✓ | Shown on success; binds to $data.<source.id>. |
| `error` | `Component` |  | Shown on failure. Defaults to a recoverable message. |

## calendar

A custom month-grid calendar. The same node does single-day, contiguous range, or multi-day selection via the bindable `mode`. All dates are ISO yyyy-MM-dd strings in $state; range uses two keys, multi uses one comma-separated key. Maps 1:1 to Compose/Aurora (pure layout + state maths).

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `mode` | `BindableString` | ✓ | 'single' \| 'range' \| 'multi'. Bindable so chips can switch it live. |
| `bind` | `string` |  | State key for the single-day selection (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| `startBind` | `string` |  | Range start state key (yyyy-MM-dd, may be empty). |
| `endBind` | `string` |  | Range end state key (yyyy-MM-dd, may be empty). |
| `multiBind` | `string` |  | Multi-select state key: comma-separated yyyy-MM-dd list. |
| `weekStart` | `BindableString` |  | 'sunday' (default) or 'monday'. |
| `color` | `Color` |  | Accent tint. |

## clips

A full-screen vertical snap-pager — an Instagram Reels / TikTok feed. Swipe up/down to page, double-tap to like. Each page carries its own media, caption and action-rail counts. Maps to a Compose VerticalPager / Aurora scroll-snap container.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `pages` | object[] | ✓ | The feed. Each page is one full-screen clip. |

## datepicker

A native date picker two-way bound to a $state key holding an ISO yyyy-MM-dd string. Each platform renders its own native calendar from the same contract.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `bind` | `string` | ✓ | State key holding the selected date (yyyy-MM-dd). |
| `style` | `graphical` · `compact` |  | Full month calendar or a compact field. |
| `color` | `Color` |  | Accent tint. |

## disclosure

A collapsible section: a tappable header (title, optional subtitle and icon) that reveals or hides its children with a spring. Self-contained — no state binding needed. Its `children` render only while open.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `title` | `BindableString` | ✓ | Header label. |
| `subtitle` | `BindableString` |  | Secondary header line. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Optional leading SF Symbol name. |
| `accent` | `Color` |  | Chevron / icon tint. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` |  | Whether it starts open (default false). |

## filecell

A document/upload cell: pick a file from the system Files app, then show its format, icon and size. Handles empty / success / error (over max size) states.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | Empty-state label (default 'Choose a file'). |
| `maxSizeKB` | `number` |  | Reject files larger than this and show an inline error. |
| `color` | `Color` |  | Accent tint. |

## list

Lazy, virtualised list. Either provide static 'children', or bind 'items' to an array and provide an item 'template'.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `items` | `BindableString` |  | Binding to a data array, e.g. '$data.feed.items'. Each element is exposed as '$item' inside the template. |
| `template` | `Component` |  | Rendered once per element of 'items'. |
| `children` | `Component`[] |  |  |
| `empty` | `Component` |  | Rendered instead of any rows when the filtered result is empty — the no-results state (SF Symbol + message + a clear-filters button). Shown live as search/filters narrow to nothing. |
| `resultCount` | `string` |  | A '$state.<key>' the filtered-total (before pagination) is mirrored into, so the contract can show a live count ('128 people') and drive the empty state. Written whenever the count changes. |
| `filter` | object |  | Live filtering. A text 'query' over 'fields', an exact 'equals' category match, and a numeric 'min'/'max' range — every value bindable to $state so a search box, chips and range inputs narrow the same list without a round-trip. |
| `sort` | object |  | Sort the (filtered) items by a field, numeric when both sides parse else lexical. |
| `spacing` | `Dimension` |  |  |
| `limit` | `BindableString` |  | Show only the first N rows. A literal number or a $state.<key> binding — pair with pagination to grow the cursor and reveal more. |
| `reorder` | `boolean` |  | When true and 'items' binds to a $state.<key> array, rows can be dragged to reorder; the new order is written back to that state key. |
| `paginateOnScroll` | `boolean` |  | Infinite scroll: reaching the last row auto-loads the next page (shows a shimmer footer, waits 'loadDelay', then fires 'onReachEnd' — or, if none, increments the $state key behind 'limit' by 6). Defaults to true whenever 'limit' binds to $state; set false to keep a manual load-more control. |
| `loadDelay` | `number` |  | Seconds the shimmer footer lingers before the next page appears, so the load reads as real work rather than an instant jump. Default 0.6. |
| `onReachEnd` | `Action` |  | Pagination hook fired when the last row appears. With paginateOnScroll it runs after the shimmer delay; without it, it fires immediately. |

## pager

A paging carousel: shows one child page at a time with page dots and optional auto-advance — the premium rotating-hero-banner pattern. Manual swipe always works; auto-advance pauses under Reduce Motion.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `children` | `Component`[] | ✓ | The pages, one shown at a time. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Page height in points (the carousel doesn't size to content). |
| `autoAdvanceMs` | `number` |  | Auto-advance interval in milliseconds; 0 (default) = manual paging only. 4000–7000 is the premium range. |
| `indicator` | `dots` · `none` |  | Page indicator style. |

## textfield

Single-line text input, two-way bound to screen state.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `bind` | `string` | ✓ | State key to read/write, e.g. 'email' or '$state.email'. |
| `placeholder` | `BindableString` |  |  |
| `secure` | `boolean` |  | Mask input (passwords). |
| `keyboardType` | `default` · `email` · `number` · `decimal` · `phone` · `url` · `numbersAndPunctuation` |  | Which keyboard to present. |
| `textContentType` | `email` · `password` · `newPassword` · `name` · `username` · `oneTimeCode` · `telephone` |  | Semantic hint for autofill / suggestions. |
| `label` | `BindableString` |  | Caption shown above the field. |
| `helper` | `BindableString` |  | Helper / validation text shown below the field; coloured by status. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Leading glyph name (SF Symbol on iOS; mapped per platform). |
| `status` | `error` · `success` · `disabled` |  | Explicit visual state. Absent = a normal focus-aware field. 'error'/'success' tint the border, helper and a trailing glyph; 'disabled' dims and blocks editing. |

## ticker

An invisible clock that advances a numeric $state value on an interval (a playing progress bar, stopwatch, live counter). Writes through the same two-way binding a slider reads.

| Prop | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|:--:|---|
| `bind` | `string` | ✓ | State key it advances. |
| `interval` | `number` |  | Seconds between ticks (default 1). |
| `step` | `number` |  | Amount added each tick (default 0.01). |
| `max` | `number` |  | Upper bound (default 1). |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  | Reset to 0 when it reaches max (default false). |
| `while` | `string` |  | Bool state key — ticks only while true. |
